def factor_price_volume_sign_coherence(df):
    """Price-volume sign coherence: rolling sum of daily price-volume direction alignment."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_diff = df_copy["volume"].diff()
    sign_product = np.sign(ret) * np.sign(vol_diff)
    coherence = sign_product.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    df_copy["factor_price_volume_sign_coherence"] = coherence
    return df_copy["factor_price_volume_sign_coherence"]
description: Simplified mutation of parent: removed volume concentration weight modifier, keeping only the core price-volume sign coherence mechanism. This reduces complexity and potential overfitting, while preserving the economic insight: stocks with persistent alignment between price direction and volume change direction exhibit conviction trends. The rolling sum over 20 days captures short-term directional consistency.
